Sana Agents is single tenant, SOC2 and ISO 27001 certified, and GDPR compliant. All data is encrypted at rest with AES 256 and in transit with TLS 1.2+. The platform follows data privacy regulations and guidelines to protect each individual user. Enterprise users can be authenticated with Single-Sign-On (SSO). Integrated systems can mirror the underlying system permissions.

Enterprise customers can use a wide range of off-the-shelf connectors. New connectors are added and included in the offering. Enterprise customers can also build custom integrations to Sana Agents. Sana Agents supports meeting recordings in Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet.

Sana Agents excels in reading documents (e.g. PDF, Powerpoint, Word, Docs), structured files (e.g. Excel, Sheets, CSV), and videos (e.g. MP4). Sana also connects to third-party systems such as CRMs with additional data types. Additional data types are added continuously.

Data added through integrations and/or through upload to Sana Agents is indexed and stored in a cloud instance. Sana Agents performs logical data isolation to keep customer data isolated. Enterprise organizations can get their own single-tenant deployment. Data at rest is encrypted with AES 256 and data in transit is encrypted with TLS 1.2+.

There are three ways documents can be added to Sana Agents, (i) through direct upload, (ii) through a private integration, and (iii) with a shared integration. The accessibility depends on how the document has been added and what admin settings are configured.
For direct uploads, access management is handled directly in Sana Agents through individual document access management or through collections. Admins can set up which users can do what.

For private integrations, each user is self-authenticating and can see results only from the scope they have access to. For example, a user can see the same results from Google Drive that they could see if searching directly from their authenticated Google Drive.
